description: Verify a Locker receipt, or a run of them oldest first, against the install's public key and the chain in ONE call, with no server and no account. Use on what get_locker_run, archive_run or an export bundle returned; never hand-roll the hash or the signature check. Pass body (the run document, or its disclosure document after a redaction) with a single receipt to also check bodySha256 or leafRoot; a redacted field still verifies by its hash. Pass publicKey to pin a key instead of trusting the one on the receipt. Returns intact, signaturesValid, brokenAt, count, nextPrevHash, keyIds, body, and anchored (false until the timestamp anchor lands).

body.description: With one receipt: the run document or disclosure document to check against it.

genesisPrevHash.description: What the first receipt's prevHash must equal (default "", a chain from its genesis).

publicKey.description: Pin this JWK; default is the key on each receipt (its thumbprint must equal keyId either way).

receipts.description: Signed receipt documents (schema locker.receipt/1), oldest first.

name: verify_receipt
title: Verify receipt
